scope: A0 P1 corrective repair 2D: law information lifecycle from crime truth through authority receipt and adjudication
changes: keeps CrimeRecord as the canonical crime fact and separates evidence/report/authority knowledge from crime truth
adds persisted CrimeEvidenceRecord and LegalReportRecord operational state linked to the underlying crime ID
replaces witness-to-instant-warrant behavior with physical survivor report delivery for at-sea crimes
uses existing sea-path geography, physical route distance and GameState.absoluteHour for report delivery timing
lets competent local/enforcing authority receive through the same lifecycle with zero transit instead of a duplicate direct-warrant path
prevents crimes without identifying witness/evidence from automatically generating warrant, heat or authority standing penalties
applies existing R1 legal heat, faction/local standing and warrants only after valid authority receipt
adds exactly-once guards against repeated report processing and duplicate legal consequences
adds independent physical-evidence and evidence-submission hooks for future investigation/customs/event systems
adds satisfied/pardoned legal-matter resolution while retaining canonical crime history
normalizes additive A0.2D fields on legacy v12 saves and infers already-valid R1 reported matters
bounds terminal operational legal-report history while preserving all in-transit reports
adds eleven dedicated A0.2D lifecycle/regression tests

cohesion.crime_truth: CrimeRecord is the one canonical fact that the crime happened; reports never duplicate the crime
cohesion.a0_1a_vessel_lifecycle: unchanged; combat/prize outcomes may create crimes/witnesses but terminal vessel/prize ownership remains A0.1A
cohesion.a0_2a_information: reuses physical geography/world-time principles while generic public news remains distinct from legal authority
cohesion.world_time: all report delivery/receipt uses GameState.absoluteHour; no private legal timer is introduced
cohesion.r1_law: existing jurisdiction heat, warrants and standing remain consequence owners and mutate only after valid authority receipt
cohesion.lawful_posture: lawful vessels continue to consume active known legal state/warrants instead of omniscient raw crime truth
cohesion.save_load: in-transit reports persist across save/load and authority receipt remains exactly once
cohesion.future_a0_3c: future war/policy/religious causes may alter institutions without replacing the law-information owner
cohesion.future_r2: customs/smuggling/privateering must consume this crime/evidence/report/warrant lifecycle rather than creating a parallel crime meter
cohesion.expansion: routing is data/geography/jurisdiction driven with no named-port branches
cohesion.presentation: accepted R1.2, Navigation, contextual-port, Crew, Naval Combat Pass 1 and atlas geometry unchanged

saveCompatibility: schema v12 unchanged; legalReports, evidence and legal-matter status are additive and normalized on load; old reported R1 crimes infer receipt/active state from existing warrants
databaseCompatibility: no new Supabase migration; canonical Alpha campaign law state remains inside versioned game_saves.snapshot and A0.2D does not create a competing normalized law owner
deferred: A0.3B character-build consequence and learning-source connection
